correctness.rationale: For w=abcde, B(w)={cde,ade,abe,abc}. Weight palindromic output 1, other 1/3. If none palindromic, a,c,e pairwise distinct and at least three distinct nonpalindromic outputs, hence local weight>=1 universally. Disjoint shadows bound codewords by q²+(q³-q²)/3. Equality forces full output partition and local weight exactly one: singleton balls are period-two ababa; other families are xbybz with distinct x,y,z, whose nonpalindromic outputs each correspond to one of three directed transitive pairs. Thus every maximizer is q independent labeled directed triple systems and D(q)^q such codes. Cited existence theorem yields equality for q>=3 and q=0,1 mod3; claims no exact A_q for q=2 mod3. Independently enumerated every word for q=2..5 and verified local shadow inequality.
